mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs due to reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production regimes (INDPRO > 120), a subsequent monthly decline in INDPRO signals supply chain disruption that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase above 3.5% signals accelerating inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), a monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market fragility that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115 signals manufacturing contraction that disrupts corporate supply chains and reduces earnings visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 115, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a synchronized demand and supply shock that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.
